prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All three harness configs now agree on `fast-coder` context window = 262144, with every other setting untouched.

## What I changed

Only one file needed editing: **`models.json`** (the source of truth). All three values in `out/` are generated from it by `gen.py`, so fixing the source and regenerating makes every harness agree by construction rather than by three hand-edits.

- `models.json`: `fast-coder.context_window` 131072 → **262144** (`deep-thinker` 200000, `tiny-chat` 32768 left as-is; `max_output` and `tool_calling` for all three left as-is).
- Ran `python gen.py` → rewrote `out/opencode.json`, `out/codex.toml`, `out/claude.json`.

## How I know it's right

Grep across the whole workspace after regeneration shows exactly four hits for the corrected value and zero for the old one:

```
models.json:3        "context_window": 262144   (fast-coder)
out/opencode.json:9  "context": 262144          (fast-coder)
out/codex.toml:2     context_window = 262144    (fast-coder)
out/claude.json:5    "contextWindow": 262144    (fast-coder)
```

A second grep for `context|context_window|contextWindow` in `out/` confirms all nine model entries are present and that `deep-thinker` (200000) and `tiny-chat` (32768) are unchanged in each of the three formats — only `fast-coder` moved. Because `gen.py` reads `models.json` and writes all three outputs in one pass, no harness can drift again without a matching edit in the shared source.

## Notes / assumptions

- The brief described OpenCode as already holding 262144 and the other two at 131072. On disk the split looked slightly different — `models.json` itself carried 131072, and `out/opencode.json` happened to hold a stale 262144 while `out/codex.toml` and `out/claude.json` held 131072. Same discrepancy, same fix: route through the single source so all three end up at 262144.
- I did not open any browser tabs, windows, or apps, so there is nothing to close.
